summary: onboarding phase complete; project is ready for coding
commands: ls -la && echo "---AIDD---" && ls -la .aidd/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---FEATURES---" && ls .aidd/features/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---FRONTEND---" && ls -la frontend/ 2>/dev/null

echo "=== active-runs ===" && cat .aidd/active-runs/*.json 2>/dev/null && echo "" && echo "=== features dirs ===" && ls .aidd/features/*/ && echo "=== latest iterations ===" && ls -t .aidd/iterations/ | head -5
for f in .aidd/features/*/feature.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done

echo "=== src tree ===" && find src -type f 2>/dev/null && echo "=== public ===" && find public -type f 2>/dev/null && echo "=== reports ===" && ls -la .aidd/reports/ .aidd/audit-reports/ .aidd/audits/ 2>/dev/null

git status --short && echo "=== git log for eslint removal ===" && git show --stat 5143148 --oneline | head -20 && echo "=== does root eslint.config.js exist? ===" && ls -la eslint.config.js frontend/ 2>/dev/null
echo "=== CHANGELOG diff vs HEAD ===" && git diff .aidd/CHANGELOG.md | head -60 && echo "=== HEAD CHANGELOG ===" && git show HEAD:.aidd/CHANGELOG.md | head -60

cd <WORKSPACE>/kanban-board
echo "=== diff untracked root eslint vs committed-deleted version ==="
git show 5143148^:eslint.config.js > /tmp/old-root-eslint.js 2>/dev/null && diff -q /tmp/old-root-eslint.js eslint.config.js && echo "IDENTICAL to deleted version"
echo "=== diff untracked frontend eslint vs committed-deleted version ==="
git show 5143148^:frontend/eslint.config.js > /tmp/old-fe-eslint.js 2>/dev/null && diff -q /tmp/old-fe-eslint.js frontend/eslint.config.js && echo "IDENTICAL to deleted version"
rm .aidd/gen-features.ts && git checkout HEAD -- .aidd/CHANGELOG.md && echo "restored CHANGELOG from HEAD" && head -8 .aidd/CHANGELOG.md

cd <WORKSPACE>/kanban-board
git add README.md .aidd/CHANGELOG.md .aidd/project-structure.md .aidd/todo.md .aidd/features/
echo "=== staged ===" && git diff --cached --stat | tail -30

cd <WORKSPACE>/kanban-board
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(aidd): onboard product feature backlog + fill tracking docs

Materialize the 8 spec.md backlog capabilities into 20 conservatively-marked
product feature.json records (23 total with existing remediations), all
passes:false/status:backlog with dependencies wired by id. Fill the
project-structure.md template with the real bare-Vite layout, add todo.md with
discovered issues (incl. the reappeared vestigial eslint config drift), and
rewrite the stock README to describe the kanban board. Restore CHANGELOG from
HEAD (working copy had been reverted to skeleton). smoke:qc verified green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

commitsCreated.subject: chore(aidd): onboard product feature backlog + fill tracking docs
